chunks: Muhammad ibn 'Abdillah ibn Ja'far al-Himyari narrated to me from his father, from Ahmad ibn 'Isa, from 'Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Saif ibn 'Amirah, from Abi Bakr al-Hadrami,

Abu 'Abdillah (peace be upon him) ordered me to increase prayer in the Mosque of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) as much as I could, and he said, 'Indeed, you cannot be there whenever you wish.' He said to me, 'Do you go to the grave of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family)?' I said, 'Yes.' He said, 'Verily, he hears you from nearby, and it reaches him [reaches him about you] if you are distant.'

key_terms.قَبْرَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ: Grave of the Messenger of Allah
key_terms.مَسْجِدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ: Mosque of the Messenger of Allah
key_terms.يُبْلَغُهُ: It reaches him / He is informed

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq say about the Prophet hearing those who visit his grave from a distance?
ai.summary: This hadith from Kamil al-Ziyarat underscores the Shia belief in the Prophet’s active spiritual presence (Hudhur) and auditory awareness (Sam'), affirming that his connection with the faithful transcends physical distance. It establishes the Mosque of the Prophet as a locus of merit where prayers are directly witnessed by the Messenger, reinforcing the theological basis for both physical and spiritual Ziyarah. This instruction highlights the accessibility of divine grace through the Prophet’s intercession and presence, regardless of the believer's location.

en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 5. Muḥammad ibn ‘Abdillāh ibn Ja’far Al-Ḥimyari narrated to me from his father, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ‘Isā, from ‘Ali ibn Ḥakam, from Sayf ibn ‘Amīrah, from Abī Bakr Al-Ḥaďrami, who said:

Abū ‘Abdillāh (Imam Sādiq (a.s.)) ordered me to increasingly pray in the Mosque of the Messenger of Allāh (s.a.a.w.) as much as I could. He told me that I would not be able to pray there whenever I wanted to. Imam (a.s.) asked me, “Do you go to the grave of the Messenger of Allāh (s.a.a.w.)?” “Yes,” I replied. Imam (a.s.) said, “Verily the Messenger of Allāh (s.a.a.w.) hears your voice (if you perform his Ziyārah) from nearby and he will be informed of you (if you perform his Ziyārah) from far.”
